Emily Chen: EdgeWave wants us to accept their compact "bandwidth_seconds" events and produce a daily invoice-preview CSV. Can we standardize conversion and a 7-day shadow run?

Raj Patel: I can own conversion. Need sample payloads. My plan: convert avg_bps*interval_seconds -> bytes, then to GB-hours. Define rounding and idempotency.

Arjun (EdgeWave): Sending sample batch to staging S3 now. Fields: event_id, device_id, ts, interval_seconds, avg_bps. We expect preview by 02:00 UTC each day.

Sofia Martinez: Staging will accept 48h late arrivals and run backfills. We'll output incomplete_event_count in the preview.

Dillon Park: Shadow plan: ingest -> convert -> aggregate per entitlement -> produce CSV -> compare partner.reported_units. Alert if delta_pct > 0.75%.

Ava (Marketing): Marketing needs two sample previews (low/high usage) and friendly SKU labels. We avoid internal bucket names in consumer copy.

Raj Patel: CSV schema: entitlement_id, sku, period_start, period_end, raw_units, converted_units, unit_price_cents, line_total_cents, notes. Will post example rows in MP-332.

ops-bot: Created ticket MP-332: "EdgeWave bandwidth_seconds ingestion + preview" assigned Raj Patel.

Emily Chen: Next steps: Raj -> lib + sample CSV by Mon EOD; Sofia -> staging + backfill job by Tue; Dillon -> monitor + alert rules; Ava -> marketing copy. I'll send kickoff doc to partner.

Arjun (EdgeWave): Sounds good. We will confirm signature scheme and replay SLA.

Emily Chen: Thanks team — reconvene after day 3 of shadow run. :thumbsup:
